section.title: Upgrading the WAR Distribution
section.p:
Use this procedure to minimize downtime when you upgrade the License Server:
Access the license server using the link on the Tomcat Web Application Manager page. If prompted for authentication, use the admin credentials.
Click the View license key link and copy the displayed license key to a file.
Go to the Tomcat Web Application Manager page, log in as a user with the admin role, and Undeploy the license server.
Download the appropriate distribution of the Oxygen License Server.
Deploy the new license server.
Access the license server using the link on the Tomcat Web Application Manager page. If prompted for authentication, use the credentials configured for the admin user.
Paste your license key into the form and register it.

section.title: Upgrading the All Platforms Distribution
section.p:
To upgrade a License Server installed from the All Platforms Distribution, follow these steps:
Stop the License Server. If it runs as a Windows service, stop the service (for example, by running stopWindowsService.bat from the Windows Service folder). Otherwise, stop the process that was started with licenseServer.bat or licenseServer.sh.
Back up the License Server installation folder.
In the installation's work folder, delete the webapp and jsp folders.Do not delete anything else from the work folder. It contains your license key, the license usage database, and the list of allowed users.
Download the new All Platforms Distribution and unpack it over the existing installation folder, replacing the existing files.
If you changed the port or other settings in Windows Service\oXygenHTTPLicenseServer.vmoptions, the new archive replaces this file with the default one. Copy your changes from the backup into the new file.
Start the License Server.
section.note: Unpack the new version in the same folder as the old one. The license activation is tied to the folder where the License Server is installed. If you install it in a different folder, the license is no longer valid for that installation. For more information, see .
